title: Greenhouse, Lever & Ashby Job Scraper — Companies' Open Roles
desc: Scrape every open role from any Greenhouse, Lever, or Ashby job board — title, department, team, location, remote flag, employment type, apply URL, and description. Paste a careers URL; platform auto-detected. Public APIs, no login.

title: Shopify Products Scraper — Barcode GTIN, Variants & Prices
desc: Full product catalogs from any Shopify store: one row per product with every variant's barcode (GTIN/EAN/UPC), SKU, price, currency, availability and stock where exposed. Custom domains and headless stores resolved automatically. Measured barcode fill: 94.1% of variants across 6 stores.

title: Job Posting Tracker — Hiring Intent Monitor & Alerts
desc: Track target companies' job boards for hiring-intent signals. Monitors public ATS feeds (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters) for NEW postings — title, department, location, date, link — with Slack/email/webhook alerts. A PredictLeads & Mantiks alternative. $4 per 1,000 postings.

title: Himalayas Scraper - Remote Jobs, Salaries & Company Profiles
desc: Scrape Himalayas remote jobs and company profiles: title, salary, seniority, countries, timezones, skills and apply link, plus company website, size, founded year, CEO, markets, tech stack, benefits and socials. Every Himalayas filter, past the 5,000-job window, companies hiring for a search.

title: FCC License Scraper - ULS Call Sign, FRN, Towers & ECFS
desc: Search FCC ULS licences by call sign, FRN, licensee, service, state, status and dates: amateur, GMRS, land mobile, microwave, cellular, PCS/AWS, paging, marine. Licensee phone, email, address, contact. Tower registrations, new-grant monitor from FCC daily files, ECFS docket filings.

title: Brazil E-commerce CNPJ Scraper - Online Seller Contacts
desc: Brazilian online-shop domains in, one seller per row out: razão social, check-digit-verified CNPJ, inscrição estadual, address, email, phone, WhatsApp and SAC, plus the Receita Federal register status. Billed only for rows with the seller's own CNPJ. $4.00 per 1,000 sellers.

title: Y Combinator Scraper - YC Companies, Founders & Open Jobs
desc: $2 per 1,000 companies; $1 on Business. Every Y Combinator company past the 1,000-result cap with its founders (LinkedIn, X, Hacker News, past companies) and open jobs (salary, equity, hiring manager, description); founder and job rows free. Paste a YC directory URL or filter by batch.

title: Shopify Store Analyzer — Theme, Apps, Products per Domain
desc: Feed it domains, get one intelligence row per store: is it Shopify (4 detection tiers), theme + version + custom flag, exact product & collection counts, price range, currency, 70+ detectable apps/pixels/payment methods, socials and contact email. No discovery — it analyzes the list you have.

title: Förderkatalog - German Federal Grants & R&D Funding Data
desc: From $0.20 per 1,000 records, no start fee. Germany's official Förderkatalog register: 301,058 federal grants and research contracts with recipient, executing body, ministry, project title, municipality key, start/end dates and the euro amount. No contact data - the register publishes none.
